message:
Have you ever wanted to play the Minecraft mod From The Caves but you don't have Minecraft? Do you just want to know what that'd be like in real life? Well have no fear ! I made an ai that'd recreate it (minus the storyline, the ai isn't good at order of events) Please try it out I worked really hard on this and had to spend like an hour just testing each event and fixing up stuff it didn't understand:
https://perchance.org/ai-character-chat?data=From_The_Caves~4bf8075061d5e9c257817896a172643d.gz
